name: 04-gameplay-hud
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Premium polished videogame UI concept for Virtual Runners, a joyful 1990s anime side-scrolling runner with existing cel-painted chibi characters. Brand '晴空跑道': bright open SKY, CLOUD WHITE and SUNSHINE ORANGE. Palette #23B5E8, #116F95, #FF8A3D, #FFFFFF, #ECF8FC, dark text #163A4B, reward yellow #F5C949. Rounded wayfinding signs, circular route nodes, pill-shaped distance markers, thin deep-lake-blue outlines and soft short shadows. Clear spacious hierarchy, large readable Traditional Chinese, functional consistent UI. Flat cel colors, no chrome or metallic letters, no black brush panels, no volleyball/sports-team shield, no navy-gold theme, no app-store ad/purchases, no floating confetti everywhere. Clean typography, no illegible tiny labels. Full-bleed landscape 16:9 screen, preferably 1920x1080 or higher, no device frame. Reference1 UI system, reference2 EXACT playable Xiaocui, reference3 established obstacle art shapes. Create a believable side-on 2D SIDE-SCROLLING GAMEPLAY screenshot with compact usable HUD. Side view ONLY, not road receding into screen or third-person racer. White city side-scrolling rooftops and distant clocktower under sunny sky; wide horizontal pale stone platform across lower 22%, a narrow gap at x62%, next platform right. Tiny Xiaocui chibi runner at x25%, feet on platform, about 18% of screen height, facing right. Ahead to right, gold star coins arc above a three-spike orange/white barrier; farther a red spring beyond the gap, recognizable from props ref. Large open forward view free of UI at screen middle. HUD strictly within top14%: left white rounded pill with Xiaocui portrait, '小翠' and exactly 3 red hearts; center slim route plaque with '1-1 白色大道' and progress line at 35% ending in checkered flag; right white pill with gold coin '42 / 80', score '0042600', separate small pause button. Numbers dark ink, consistent thin blue borders. No rank board, no speed/meter counters because level mode, no boss bar, no extra giant central title, no RPG skills. Bottom-left understated tiny keyboard keycaps and words '↑ 跳' '↓ 滑' '→ 衝' above safe margin; no huge touch buttons in this desktop concept. Playfield uncluttered and realistic collision space. Keep background calmer than foreground. Full single screenshot.
